authority: H-76 specifies branches; H-66 semantic fidelity, H-54/H-77 cancellation and H-71 contextual modulation remain. No numerical thresholds chosen.
value_question: Which distinctions must the simple token-entry rule preserve without adding normalization or state machinery by default?

gain_analysis.assumptions: Illustrative nonzero vector v, linear aggregate output y_d=g_d*v_d, positive gains. This describes a diagnostic transformation, not the combined nonlinear network.
gain_analysis.formula: With w_d=v_d^2/sum(v^2), cosine(v,y)=E_w[g]/sqrt(E_w[g^2]). Uniform positive gain preserves direction; coordinate-varying gain can change it.
gain_analysis.limit: Fixed per-cell h/l values are illustrative, not selected. Context-dependent changes can be intended; this does not impose runtime projection back to the input token.

input_vs_response.distinction: Faithful representation of the supplied token, its confidence-dependent cellular recruitment, and the resulting context-plus-input network state are separate observables.
input_vs_response.reason: H-54/H-77 intentionally combine token input with prior state and cancel opposing activity; H-71 intends history to alter later responses. Requiring every contextual output to equal the isolated token would erase those goals.
input_vs_response.assessment: Evaluate isolated-token semantic recurrence under its specified entry conditions, and evaluate context-dependent or complementary-input behavior against the corresponding behavioral target. Do not normalize the full post-cancellation state to the latest token by default.

conditional_bounded_rate_feasibility.condition: If a finite per-cell maximum r_max is later selected and an exact aggregate input budget I is required
conditional_bounded_rate_feasibility.bound: m*r_max >= I is necessary for a selected group of size m; otherwise no per-cell calibration can meet both constraints.
conditional_bounded_rate_feasibility.limit: Neither r_max nor exact input-budget preservation is selected. This identifies a conditional compatibility requirement, not an extra saturation/gating mechanism.

broad_input_and_coverage.arithmetic: One sign per nonzero coordinate with all60 cells weakly recruited reaches307200 of614400 cell identities, i.e.50% support in that presentation.
distinctions: Nonzero state support, counted active cells and qualified flexible-window coverage are different quantities.
H-57 illustrative20% flow cap applies to qualified coverage, not automatically every nonzero weak rate.
A transient unfamiliar-token response may differ from settled flow; no instantaneous DMN classification follows.
broad_input_and_coverage.limit: No new token/noise provenance flags, detector, cutoff, window or exception to user coverage requirements is introduced.

minimal_state_sufficiency.criterion: Two histories with the same stored snapshot must lead to the same next-state law under the same next input/noise and fixed learned graph; otherwise a required distinction is missing.
alternatives: One scalar whose activity ranges carry the chosen phases.
Prediction derived deterministically from the existing snapshot and learned incoming graph, without independent persistent readiness.
Separate evolving readiness only if required behavior distinguishes histories that the existing snapshot cannot distinguish.
minimal_state_sufficiency.timing_caution: Checking a stored phase and deriving new readiness from the snapshot are different transition schedules; do not silently interchange them.
minimal_state_sufficiency.limit: Separate semantic meanings do not alone require separate arrays. No option is selected pending the current discussion.

generation_learning_boundary: H-84: generation input calibration and evaluation of ensuing recurrence do not make the explicit broad weak fallback a teaching pattern or ordinary synaptic propagation to be learned. These conditional arithmetic results do not select flow learning targets.
